project_type: Two repos. API: Express 5 + Mongoose 8 + Zod 3.25 on STANDALONE MongoDB, layered routes -> controllers -> services -> models, pure views in src/views. Admin: Next 16 App Router client pages, React 19, TypeScript strict, plain fetch through a same-origin /api rewrite, lucide-react, native <dialog> Modal.
build_system: npm in each repo. API: tsc (tsconfig.build.json) -> dist. Admin: next build; the /api rewrite target is baked at build time from API_PROXY_TARGET, so run builds with API_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4010 and make sure no leaked NODE_ENV=development is set (it breaks next build).
test_framework: API: vitest (tests/**/*.test.ts, node env, NO Mongo, NO HTTP; vitest.config.mts injects throwaway env incl. UPLOAD_DIR=./uploads-unit-test). Admin: none and none is added; verification = typecheck + build.
build_command: API: npm run build (cwd c:/Project/running-event-api). Admin: npm run build (cwd c:/Project/running-event-admin).
test_command: API: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build. Admin: npm run typecheck && npm run build.
verification_instructions: After each FEAT: run the API trio (typecheck, test, build) if API files changed and the admin pair (typecheck, build) if admin files changed. tests/views/golden.test.ts compares JSON byte-for-byte against tests/fixtures/golden-views.json and must stay green WITHOUT regenerating the fixture. Live HTTP verification against a throwaway standalone mongod (7.0.12 is installed locally; no --replSet) is done once by the convergence fixer, see plan.md section 5.
snapshot_or_generated_files: tests/fixtures/golden-views.json is a checked-in contract snapshot: never regenerate or edit it. dist/ is build output (gitignored). tsconfig.tsbuildinfo / next-env.d.ts in the admin are generated; do not hand-edit.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell, absolute paths only. NEVER contact http://14.207.142.107:4000 or any deployed server. NO git add / commit / push (user did not ask; design says no commits; no worktree). Never touch c:/Project/run-event-platform. Do not read or print .env / .env.local secrets. Temporary scripts, mongod data dirs and upload dirs must live outside both repos and be deleted. Tests that write files (UPLOAD_DIR=./uploads-unit-test, not gitignored) must clean up in afterAll. MongoDB is standalone: no transactions/sessions anywhere.
contribution_requirements: No new runtime dependencies. Zod validators; role guards read/write/superOnly from API/src/routes/admin.routes.ts; origin check and JSON content-type middleware already apply; response helpers ok/created/done (src/utils/response.ts); HTTP_STATUS constants; ApiError with UPPER_SNAKE codes and Thai messages; constants live in src/config/constants.ts; list endpoints use pageQuery + skipOf/pageMeta; audit() (never throws) for every new mutation. Views are pure (no DB, no Date.now). Additive contract: only new keys/endpoints/optional params, never remove/rename a key or change a value. Admin: types in src/lib/api/types.ts, calls in src/lib/api/endpoints/*.ts re-exported in src/lib/api/index.ts, useAsync, data-states (LoadingState/ErrorState/EmptyState/Pager), toasts via useToast, canWrite/isSuper, fieldErrorsFor/formMessage, no any, Thai copy, confirm dialog for destructive actions, accessible Modal.
key_patterns: Admin root is c:/Project/running-event-admin/src/ (all admin paths relative to it). API source root c:/Project/running-event-api/src/, tests c:/Project/running-event-api/tests/. Event writes: event-write.service.ts uses Undo[] + runUndo from utils/compensation.ts and conditional single-document updates (no transactions). Order detail is built in services/order/order-admin.service.ts getAdmin and used by cancel/tracking/approve/reject (review.service.ts) so every mutation returns the same detail shape. Shared lean-doc helper withId() (utils/lean.ts) puts id first and keeps stored key order. Admin pages: client components, `const { data, error, loading, reload } = useAsync((signal) => api.fn(..., signal), deps)`, filters reset page via changeFilter(), Modal from components/ui.tsx. Errors: formMessage(failure) returns error.message when the API sends no fields (use it for form-level alerts, incl. 409 EMAIL_TAKEN). PLAN IS AUTHORITATIVE: c:/Project/running-event-admin/.agents/tasks/admin-full-integration/plan.md (binding amendments, open decisions, item-by-item steps); design.md is secondary and has a banner pointing to plan.md.
directory_structure: API: src/{config,routes,controllers,services(+event/,order/),models,validators,views,middlewares,utils,seed}, tests/{views,fixtures}, postman/, README.md. Admin: src/app/(admin)/*/page.tsx client pages, src/app/login, src/components (shell, ui, data-states, change-password-modal), src/features/admin (providers, order-detail, event-images*, format, permissions, use-async), src/lib (constants, api/{client,errors,query,types,index,endpoints/*}), docs/SYSTEM.md, README.md, .agents/tasks (plan artifacts).
